    StartersNew York bodega bagel bitesMini bagels with chive cream cheese, smoked salmon, capers and dillHow to make it12 mini bagels200g cream cheese2 tbsp chopped chives1 lemon200g smoked salmon2 tbsp capers1 red onion, in slivers1 small bunch dillSplit the bagels and toast until golden.Beat the cream cheese with the chives and a squeeze of lemon. Spread thickly on each bagel half.Top with smoked salmon, capers, red onion and dill.Finish with cracked pepper and serve on a board with lemon wedges.Nutcracka hunt hot honey buffalo wingsCrisp baked wings tossed in hot sauce, butter and honeyHow to make it1.2kg chicken wings2 tsp baking powder1 tsp salt50g butter100ml hot sauce1 tbsp honey100g sour cream3 tbsp mayonnaise3 tbsp buttermilk1 small bunch chives, chopped1 small bunch dill, chopped1/2 tsp garlic powder2 carrots, cut into sticks4 celery sticksPat the wings dry and toss with the baking powder and salt.Bake on a rack at 220°C, turning once, until crisp.Melt the butter with the hot sauce and honey and toss the wings through.Mix the sour cream, mayonnaise, buttermilk, chopped chives, chopped dill and garlic powder for the ranch.Serve with carrot and celery sticks.Potato latkes with sour cream and appleFor Isaac, Star of David jumper and all.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsSliders and mac and cheese party plateCheeseburger sliders with pickles and baked mac and cheese cupsHow to make it500g beef mince6 slices of cheddar, halved12 slider buns12 dill pickle slices250g macaroni200g tasty cheese, grated400ml full cream milkCook the macaroni until just tender and drain.Mix the macaroni with the cheese and milk and spoon into greased muffin tins.Bake at 190°C until golden.Shape the mince into small patties and cook on both sides, topping with the cheddar slices to melt.Serve in slider buns with pickles alongside the mac and cheese cups.Isaac's Christmas Eve beef and broccoliChristmas in New York, the Chinese restaurant wayHow to make it600g rump steak, thinly sliced2 tbsp soy sauce1 tsp cornflour3 tbsp oyster sauce1 tsp sesame oil1 tsp sugar2 tbsp vegetable oil1 head broccoli, in small florets3 garlic cloves, sliced15g ginger, cut in matchsticks300g jasmine riceToss the beef with half the soy and the cornflour. Mix the oyster sauce, the rest of the soy, sesame oil, sugar and 4 tbsp water.Rinse the rice and simmer it, covered, until the water is gone. Rest it with the lid on.Stir-fry the beef in a very hot wok with half the oil in two batches. Lift out.Stir-fry the broccoli, garlic and ginger in the rest of the oil with a splash of water until bright, return the beef, add the sauce and toss until glossy.SweetsChristmas gingerbread cakeSticky ginger and golden syrup cakeHow to make it125g butter150g golden syrup100g brown sugar250g self-raising flour2 tsp ground ginger1 egg150ml full cream milk150g icing sugar1 lemon, juicedMelt the butter with the golden syrup and brown sugar.Mix in the flour, ginger, egg and milk.Pour into a lined tin and bake at 170°C.Cool the cake.Mix the icing sugar with lemon juice and spread over.DrinksChristmas Eve mulled grape juiceRed grape juice and black tea simmered with orange, honey, cinnamon, star anise and cloveHow to make it600ml red grape juice250ml strong black tea250ml orange juice1 tbsp honey2 cinnamon sticks2 star anises6 cloves1 orange, slicedPour the grape juice and tea into a saucepan with the orange juice, honey, cinnamon sticks, star anise, cloves and orange slices.Heat gently, keeping it below a simmer.Ladle into mugs with an orange slice each.
